name: Ruins of Ordil'Aran
summary: In northwestern Ashenvale, the Ruins of Ordil'Aran lie between Maestra's Post and Bathran's Haunt. Thistlefur furbolgs have overrun the ancient night elf settlement, once a hidden refuge for shadow cultists.

sections.title: A Contested Ruin
sections.body: Weathered pillars and cracked arches are all that remain of Ordil'Aran's Kaldorei buildings. The Cult of the Dark Strand once hid among the stones, ambushing travelers on Ashenvale's northwestern paths. Recently, Thistlefur furbolgs drove the cultists out in a bloody takeover. Fallen Dark Strand practitioners still litter the ground, while the furbolgs patrol the perimeter and guard the ancient Heartswood tree within the ruins.

faq.answer: Ordil'Aran began as an ancient night elf settlement before the Great Sundering. Like many Kaldorei outposts across Ashenvale, it decayed over millennia, leaving overgrown arches and crumbling masonry.

faq.q: Why are there dead cultists lying around the ruins?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand used the ruins as a base until Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and drove them out. Slain cultists remain strewn across the site.
The Heartswood is an ancient tree growing within the Ruins of Ordil'Aran. Its branches and wood are sought for their potent magical and natural properties.
Thistlefur furbolgs occupy the ruins now. They killed or drove out the Dark Strand cultists who lived there before.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the ruins defiled by corrupt furbolgs and dark cultists.
Just north of Maestra's Post, Ordil'Aran's aggressive occupants threaten Alliance scouts and travelers heading toward Darkshore.
